# Kenney audio (CC0) + OpenGameArt music (CC0) used by tribe3d.html

Downloaded by Claude on the owner's PC on 2026-11-16 (owner: "ให้ Claude โหลดเอง").

- Kenney (https://kenney.nl), licence CC0 1.0, `License_*.txt` copied unchanged:
  - Impact Sounds (kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds): impactPunch_medium, impactWood_medium, impactWood_heavy, impactSoft_medium, impactSoft_heavy, impactMining (5 each).
  - RPG Audio (kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio): drawKnife1-3 (also in the repo, unused yet: chop, creak1, handleCoins).
  - Interface Sounds (kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds): click_001-003.
  - Music Jingles (kenney.nl/assets/music-jingles): jingles_STEEL02 (dawn), jingles_STEEL14 (defeat), jingles_HIT15 (boss).
  - Files in `art/tribe3d/sfx/`, unchanged .ogg. Only these files are stored, not the whole packs.
- OpenGameArt.org, licence CC0 (checked on each page on 2026-11-16), files in `art/tribe3d/music/`, unchanged:
  - `day_jungleloop.ogg` = "Jungleloop" (opengameart.org/content/jungleloop).
  - `night_jungle_battle_loop.ogg` = "Jungle Battle Loop" (opengameart.org/content/jungle-battle-loop, file BattleLoop2_0.ogg).
  - `raid_prehistoric_drums.ogg` = "Prehistoric Drum Loop" (opengameart.org/content/prehistoric-drum-loop, file select.ogg), played once as the raid horn.
